title: Whole Number Operations Review
description: Review and extend mastery of multi-digit addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
objectives: Fluently multiply multi-digit numbers
Divide with remainders up to 4-digit dividends
Solve multi-step word problems using all four operations

lessons.title: Multi-Digit Multiplication
lessons.content: Multiply numbers with multiple digits using the standard algorithm.

lessons.title: Long Division
lessons.content: Divide multi-digit dividends by one- and two-digit divisors.

title: Fractions — Adding and Subtracting
description: Add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers with unlike denominators.
objectives: Find the least common denominator
Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators
Add and subtract mixed numbers with regrouping

lessons.title: Unlike Denominators
lessons.content: To add or subtract fractions, convert to a common denominator first.

lessons.title: Mixed Number Subtraction with Regrouping
lessons.content: Sometimes you need to regroup the whole number part before subtracting.

title: Fractions — Multiplying and Dividing
description: Multiply and divide fractions and mixed numbers.
objectives: Multiply fractions by fractions and whole numbers
Divide fractions by fractions using the reciprocal
Interpret fraction multiplication and division in context

lessons.title: Multiplying Fractions
lessons.content: Multiply numerators together and denominators together.

lessons.title: Dividing Fractions
lessons.content: Dividing by a fraction is the same as multiplying by its reciprocal.

title: Decimals — Operations
description: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths and thousandths.
objectives: Add and subtract decimals
Multiply decimals by decimals
Divide decimals by whole numbers and decimals

lessons.title: Adding and Subtracting Decimals
lessons.content: Line up decimal points, then add or subtract as with whole numbers.

lessons.title: Multiplying and Dividing Decimals
lessons.content: Multiply normally, then count total decimal places for the product.

title: Volume
description: Understand volume as a measure of 3D space; calculate volume of rectangular prisms.
objectives: Define volume and its units
Use the formula V = l × w × h
Find volume of composite figures

lessons.title: Volume Formula
lessons.content: Volume = length × width × height, measured in cubic units.
examples: A box 5 cm × 3 cm × 4 cm: V = 60 cm³
A room 12 ft × 10 ft × 8 ft: V = 960 ft³

lessons.title: Composite Volumes
lessons.content: Split irregular shapes into rectangular prisms and add volumes.
examples: An L-shaped prism: split into two boxes, calculate each, then add

title: Coordinate Plane
description: Plot and interpret points on the coordinate plane in the first quadrant.
objectives: Identify x- and y-axes and the origin
Plot ordered pairs in the first quadrant
Use coordinate graphs to solve real-world problems

lessons.title: The Coordinate Plane
lessons.content: The x-axis is horizontal; y-axis is vertical; origin is (0,0).
examples: Plot A(2,4), B(5,4), C(5,1) — they form an L shape

lessons.title: Graphing Patterns
lessons.content: Graph related number pairs to identify patterns.
examples: Rule: y = 2x. Points: (1,2),(2,4),(3,6),(4,8) — a straight line

title: Properties of 2D Figures
description: Classify 2D figures in a hierarchy based on their properties.
objectives: Classify quadrilaterals by properties
Understand the hierarchy of polygons
Calculate area of complex polygons

lessons.title: Quadrilateral Hierarchy
lessons.content: All rectangles are parallelograms, but not all parallelograms are rectangles.
examples: Trapezoid: only one pair of parallel sides
Rhombus: all sides equal; diagonals are perpendicular

lessons.title: Area of Complex Shapes
lessons.content: Decompose complex shapes into simpler ones.
examples: Area of an L-shape: split into 2 rectangles, compute each, add

title: Number Patterns and Expressions
description: Write and evaluate numerical expressions and identify arithmetic patterns.
objectives: Write numerical expressions with parentheses
Evaluate expressions using order of operations
Generate and analyze number patterns

lessons.title: Order of Operations
lessons.content: Use PEMDAS: Parentheses, Exponents, Multiply/Divide (left to right), Add/Subtract.

lessons.title: Arithmetic Patterns
lessons.content: Rules can generate sequences of numbers.

title: Data and Statistics
description: Represent and interpret data using line plots, bar graphs, and frequency tables.
objectives: Create and read line plots with fractions
Interpret bar and line graphs
Find mean, median, and mode

lessons.title: Line Plots with Fractions
lessons.content: Plot fractional data on a number line.
examples: Heights: 4 1/2, 4 3/4, 4 1/2, 5, 4 3/4 — mark each on a line plot

lessons.title: Mean, Median, Mode
lessons.content: Three measures of center describe typical data values.

title: Introduction to Ratios
description: Introduce ratio concepts as a foundation for 6th-grade ratio reasoning.
objectives: Understand a ratio as a comparison
Write ratios in multiple forms
Find equivalent ratios

lessons.title: What is a Ratio?
lessons.content: A ratio compares two quantities. It can be written as a:b, a/b, or 'a to b'.
examples: 10 boys and 12 girls: boys to girls = 10:12 = 5:6

lessons.title: Equivalent Ratios
lessons.content: Multiply or divide both parts of a ratio by the same number.
